question.text: CBDT Circular No. 6/2016 on treatment of income from transfer of listed shares — key rule:

answer.text: If fund opts to treat listed shares/securities held >12 months as Capital Gains, AO cannot dispute; decision binds fund in subsequent years

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.3, CBDT Circular 6/2016 grants election to treat >12-month listed shares as Capital Gains; election binds in subsequent years. The Trap: Other statements understate the commitment. Cross-Exam Context: Key CBDT clarification reducing litigation. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document the election in the fund's annual return — lock-in binds subsequent years.
